name: export-create-then-attach-with-state
summary: Two-call ERP export through an HTTPS middleware - create the financial document, then attach the original file - with a Data Storage state record as the duplicate guard, BAPIRET2 severity as the verdict, and a timed-out create recorded as unknown and never auto-retried.

state_dataset.description: Data Storage collection holding one export-state record per annotation (the duplicate guard)

reference_field.description: schema id of the supplier's invoice number - REF_DOC_NO, the ERP's dedup and reconciliation key

document_date_field.description: schema id of the invoice date

currency_field.description: schema id of the document currency

gross_amount_field.description: schema id of the gross total

document_type_field.description: schema id of the document type; credit_note / credit_memo flip INVOICE_IND

company_code_field.description: schema id of the company code (often a per-queue default_value)

line_items_field.description: schema id of the line-item multivalue

line_po_number_field.description: line schema id of the MATCHED PO number - from matching, never the page

line_po_item_field.description: line schema id of the matched PO item number

line_amount_field.description: line schema id of the line net amount, in the header currency

line_quantity_field.description: line schema id of the invoiced quantity, in the PO unit

line_uom_field.description: line schema id of the PO unit of measure (from the matched PO line)

line_text_field.description: line schema id of the item text

line_gr_required_field.description: line schema id of the PO line's goods-receipt flag ("X"), written by matching

line_open_qty_field.description: line schema id of the GR-aware invoiceable quantity (delivered - invoiced), written by matching

line_unit_price_field.description: line schema id of the PO unit price, for the value fallback of the receipt guard

line_tolerance_pct_field.description: line schema id of the PO line's over-delivery tolerance in percent

doc_number_field.description: write-back: ERP document number; edit: disabled - an operator editing it defeats the duplicate guard

fiscal_year_field.description: write-back: fiscal year the document was created in

message_field.description: write-back: flattened BAPIRET2 messages for the operator

provenance: Lifted from a production export hook (2026-08/09) posting PO-backed invoices into SAP through a customer HTTPS middleware that wraps BAPI-style RFCs. Verified end to end against the customer's staging SAP: create parked (RBSTAT A) on a real open PO line; attach; re-attach with the same external id returned the SAME archive id with the already-exists flag set; four real invoices parked in one run. Generalized here (BAPI-named keys, adaptable response contract) and not yet run in this form - hence candidate.
notes: Never default invoice_status to posting; "A" parks so AP reviews in SAP before anything hits the ledger. posting_date_today defaults true - the customer's own example posted today's date for a document dated months earlier; the document date fails the first time an invoice arrives from a closed period. Response key names (DOC_NUMBER_KEY, ARCHIVE_ID_KEY with its trailing period, ALREADY_EXISTS_KEY) are copied verbatim from a live response, not the consumer guide - the guide's documented IV_*/EV_* names were the internal RFC signature and were rejected. ET_RETURN.NUMBER arrives as a JSON integer, not the documented zero-padded string. Ask the customer for a read-back endpoint (by REF_DOC_NO + company code) or confirm SAP's duplicate check on REF_DOC_NO is active - until then a timed-out create stays a human reconciliation.
